**One-sentence takeaway:** Alphabet is a structurally dominant business with legitimate AI infrastructure exposure, but the FCF compression and stretched EV/FCF multiple make this a hold-and-monitor rather than a high-conviction entry point until capex intensity normalizes and free cash flow catches up to operating earnings.
